text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give it my all! Even if it's step by agonizing step,
forward, ever forward!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Step by step toward my goal!
If I let my guard down, even Dia-chan
will catch up to me in no time.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (I debuted before she did, but Dia-chan has always caught up in no time!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later, I was waiting for Satono Diamond
to arrive so we could coordinate our next tandem training schedule, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Dia-chan is running late. She's almost never tardy, though...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm... She said she had an important discussion
at Dia-chan's house today.
Though she didn't say what it was about...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Kita-chan.
I'm sorry I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan!
No, I don't mind, but did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You know... there's something I need to
talk to you and Kita-chan about today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You know... Kita-chan and I—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Turns out we won't be able to run together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, what do you mean
we can't run together... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea. It's not like
I have to drop out of Tracen Academy or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They just said it would be impossible for me to run in the same class as Kita-chan. After talking it over with my family and the doctors today, that's what was decided.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There's just nothing that can be done about this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Just that"...? Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Hearing this much makes the situation clear.
In other words..."
choice_data_list: So you're saying she hasn't reached her peak growth period yet?
That means she hasn't reached her peak growth period yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is correct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Awakening. The budding period where an Umamusume's
racing abilities grow tremendously.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The timing for that phase differs from person to person.
It has arrived for Kitasan Black, but likely not yet for Satono Diamond..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Training alongside Kita-chan,
I kind of had an idea.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is growing, yet
I'm not. I started wondering if maybe...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No way... We can't run as classmates...?
Then what about the Satsuki Sho and the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, can't we do
something about this? Isn't there any way...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I thought, there was no other way.
And then—
choice_data_list: Dia, you waited until the very last second, right?
Dia, you waited until the very last moment, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Exactly as you guessed. I wanted to
debut at the same time as Kita-chan, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, it's gotten to the point where
I simply can't wait any longer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If there are no signs of peak condition at this point, we won't make it in time. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I figured it would be best to put debut-oriented training on hold and return to basic training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If she pushes too hard in training and somehow gets injured...
it would cast a dark shadow over Satono's long-cherished dream
of claiming the family's first GⅠ victory."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That risk must be avoided at all costs.
Therefore, it was decided today that the debut will be next year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This is... the family's consensus.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Then, is it because of what
your uncle or aunt told you?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it, Kita-chan.
I just felt like this was what I needed to do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Precious friendship... But there are also things
more important that must be cherished.
Just as you want to make everyone smile, Kita-chan."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "I want to stay Kita-chan's friend while treasuring the things that matter to me. Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I wouldn't want Kita-chan to throw away
what matters to her just for my sake.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Will you... understand?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yup, yeah, I get it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's because Dia-chan is like that that I wanted to become friends with her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I have to bear with it. Even if I get
a little lonely. Even if you're not there chasing
after me in races anymore...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after me... won't you?
Wait, isn't that a bit off?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why?
I mean, we can't run in the same race, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But try to look at it from a broader perspective.
Like how God might look down on us from high up in the sky.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan walks a little ahead of me in time.
And I will follow in the time after,
walking the exact same path she did.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't that basically mean chasing after it,
if you look at it from high above?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right!
As expected of Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Then, just like back then...

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Kita-cha~n, wait up, wait up~!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Dia-chan, this way!
Watch your step so you don't trip, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"Just follow my lead and everything'll be fine!
I'll show you sights you've never seen before."

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text: Whoa... so this is...!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
See? I'll show you tons and tons of sights
you'd never see at home! From now on, always!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So Kita-chan, please take care of me from now on, too.
Our training routines will be different, and we'll be a bit apart, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose sight of your back, Kita-chan.
I'll be chasing right behind you, cheering you on all the way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan... Yeah, I got it.
I get it now! After all, we've never stayed separated before!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I promise! As the big sister figure,
I'll work hard ahead of you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A parting of ways has come for the two who were always together.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Let's believe that this parting will make them both stronger.
From here on, Kitasan Black
will walk on her own."
